reason: Conversation 2 delivered the complete emergency procedure immediately in its first reply - no switches, no flames, turn off at the meter, ventilate, leave, call 0800 111 999 - which is exactly the expected sensible first step for a strong lingering gas smell after a 'whoomph'.
